clusters.headline: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.5 with native voice and longer context
clusters.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.5 with a native voice mode and a 2M-token context window, available first to ChatGPT Pro and API Tier 4 users. Pricing on the API drops roughly 20% versus GPT-5 for equivalent inputs.

clusters.headline: Fed holds rates steady, signals one more cut before year-end
clusters.summary: The FOMC kept the benchmark rate in the 4.00–4.25% range and softened forward guidance, with the dot plot now implying a single 25bp cut by December. Treasury yields fell across the curve and the dollar weakened.

clusters.headline: Bitcoin tops $138K as spot ETF inflows hit fresh record
clusters.summary: Bitcoin briefly traded above $138,000 after spot BTC ETFs absorbed $1.4B of net inflows on Tuesday, the largest single-day total since launch. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for over half the flow.

clusters.headline: EU agrees framework on AI liability after marathon Brussels session
clusters.summary: Member states reached a provisional deal on the AI Liability Directive, giving consumers a clearer path to sue developers and deployers of high-risk systems. Final adoption is expected before the summer recess.

clusters.headline: Anthropic launches Claude on-prem appliance for regulated industries
clusters.summary: Anthropic unveiled a hardware appliance bundling Claude models with its safety stack, aimed at banks, hospitals, and government agencies that can't ship data off premises. Pricing starts in the high six figures annually.

clusters.headline: Nvidia reports record quarter, lifts guidance on data-center demand
clusters.summary: Nvidia posted Q1 revenue of $48.2B, beating estimates by $1.7B, and raised its Q2 outlook citing sustained AI infrastructure spend. Shares rose 6% in extended trading.

clusters.headline: SEC drops appeal in Ripple case, ending five-year saga
clusters.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission filed to dismiss its remaining appeal against Ripple Labs, leaving the 2023 ruling that XRP is not a security on secondary markets effectively final. XRP rallied 12% on the news.

clusters.headline: Yen weakens past 162 per dollar, BOJ steps up jawboning
clusters.summary: The yen slipped past 162 to the dollar overnight, prompting Japan's finance ministry to warn it would 'take all necessary actions' against speculative moves. Markets are pricing in only a small chance of a near-term rate hike.

clusters.headline: MIT team demonstrates room-temperature superconductivity in thin film
clusters.summary: Researchers at MIT report a copper-hydride thin film that exhibits zero electrical resistance up to 22°C at modest pressures. Independent labs are racing to replicate; results posted to arXiv await peer review.

clusters.headline: Google releases Gemini 3 Ultra, opens free tier to developers
clusters.summary: Google launched Gemini 3 Ultra with reasoning improvements and multimodal generation, plus a developer free tier of 1,500 requests per day. Benchmarks show parity with GPT-5 on coding and lead on long-context tasks.

clusters.headline: Amazon to spin off AWS, source says, unlocking $1.5T valuation
clusters.summary: Amazon's board has approved an in-principle plan to spin off AWS as a standalone listed company, according to a person familiar with the matter. The move would create one of the largest listed pure-play cloud businesses.

clusters.headline: Ethereum Pectra+ upgrade ships, slashes L2 fees by 40%
clusters.summary: The Pectra+ hard fork activated on mainnet without incident, lowering blob data costs and bringing average L2 fees on Arbitrum and Base under one cent. Validator participation held steady at 99.6%.

clusters.headline: UN Security Council passes Gaza reconstruction resolution
clusters.summary: A resolution authorizing a multilateral reconstruction fund for Gaza passed 13-0 with two abstentions. The fund will be administered jointly by the UN, World Bank, and a regional Arab oversight board.

clusters.headline: WHO confirms first effective oral vaccine for malaria
clusters.summary: The World Health Organization endorsed an oral malaria vaccine that showed 78% efficacy against severe disease in a 14,000-child trial across four African countries. Rollout via Gavi is scheduled for Q3.

clusters.headline: S&P 500 closes at record after soft inflation print
clusters.summary: The S&P 500 finished up 1.1% at a fresh all-time high after core PCE came in at 2.3% YoY, slightly below consensus. Tech and consumer discretionary led; small caps lagged.

clusters.headline: EU's AI Office proposes mandatory model cards for foundation models above 10^25 FLOPs
clusters.summary: The European AI Office published a draft technical standard requiring detailed model cards, evaluation results, and red-team summaries for any foundation model trained above the 10^25 FLOP threshold. Industry consultation runs until June.
